_meta.rule: This file may name NOTHING specific to a place. If a value here would differ between two households, it does not belong here — it belongs in what the person tells us at onboarding.
_meta.ruling: paul-ruled 2026-09-06 R4: production ships the full app, built from its own instance, as the same artifact QA certified. R5: a domain with nothing in it is EMPTY, not absent — the section exists and says it holds nothing yet.

theme._note: the profile colour is chosen by the person at onboarding and stored on their account; this is only what an unconfigured build paints.
